enrichment method: Rapid immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry of endogenous proteins (RIME)
Rapid immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry of endogenous proteins (RIME) and proximity-based biotinylation with an APEX2 tag were used to identify PRDM1-interacting proteins.
labeling: We performed mass spectrometry (MS) to investigate the peptide sequences of PRDM1 isoforms.
